packages.name: SynoPkgOpenList
packages.notes:
4.2.7-0013
- Native OIDC single sign-on from the DSM main menu; DSM administrators only. One designated administrator owns the OpenList admin account; other administrators receive ordinary OpenList accounts.
- Adds 49 bounded ctl commands; business commands verify the designated owner and writes require confirmation.
- Rebuilt with released CLI/templates/SDK/App 0.19.0, executor/v0.19.0 and UI 0.12.5. CLI check/build/inspect pass with findings=[].
- Upgrade from 0012 preserves existing data and settings; OIDC, non-administrator denial and three read-only ctl commands were checked. Manual shared-folder permissions and Local storage setup remain required. External WebDAV is not enabled.

packages.name: SynoPkgUptimeKuma
packages.notes:
2.5.6-0009
- Official upstream icon and digest-locked Uptime Kuma 2.5.6 container.
- DSM-managed HTTPS, DSM administrator sign-in, explicit non-admin HTTP 403 and no published container port.
- HTTP monitoring, Socket.IO, data-preserving upgrade, restart and uninstall retention checked on DSM.
- SDK/App 0.17.5, templates 0.17.8, UI 0.12.4; original build inspected with CLI 0.17.7, findings=[].
- Delete-data still retains the Compose named volume; the wizard reports the exact retained name. No ctl interface.

packages.name: SynoPkgFreshRSS
packages.notes:
1.30.1-0015
- First catalog preview with native OIDC single sign-on and DSM administrator-only access; non-administrators receive HTTP 403.
- Official FreshRSS 1.30.1 container pinned by immutable digest, a nonroot runtime, private package data and automatic feed refresh.
- Released CLI/templates/SDK/App 0.19.0, executor/v0.19.0 and UI release-set pin 0.12.5; check/build/inspect findings=[].
- Rebuilt SPK is byte-identical to the device-verified candidate for upgrade retention, main-menu OIDC and non-administrator denial. Compose volume retention is reported during uninstall.
